key_insight: Factorize instruction-guided video editing into separate semantic anchoring and motion alignment components so the model can apply precise semantic changes while faithfully preserving original motion — without relying on brittle external priors.
problem_solved: Existing instruction-guided video editors trade off between accurate semantic edits and preserving motion, and they often depend on external priors (e.g., VLM features or structural conditions) that hurt robustness and generalization.
method: Semantic Anchoring: inject and hold target semantic information (from the instruction) in a dedicated latent/conditioning pathway so edits stay semantically precise and localized.

Motion Alignment: enforce temporal consistency and motion preservation through a motion-aware alignment module (e.g., alignment losses or temporally-aware attention) that decouples motion from semantic change.
End-to-end factorized pipeline that applies edits in the video latent space, minimizing dependence on explicit external priors and improving robustness/generalization.
impact: Enables higher-fidelity, instruction-driven video edits that keep original motion dynamics intact, making production-quality editing more reliable. Practitioners gain a more robust, generalizable approach for multimodal video manipulation without heavy external conditioning.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing two parallel branches: Semantic Anchoring (semantic injection) and Motion Alignment (temporal/motion module), merging into edited video output.
Before/after frame sequence that highlights preserved motion trajectories alongside localized semantic changes.
Illustration of temporal alignment (e.g., motion vectors or attention heatmaps) to show how motion is preserved across frames.
Bar/line chart comparing edit accuracy vs. motion preservation/error against prior methods (demonstrating improved trade-off).
paper_title: SAMA: Factorized Semantic Anchoring and Motion Alignment for Instruction-Guided Video Editing
paper_authors: Xinyao Zhang, Wenkai Dong, Yuxin Song, Bo Fang, Qi Zhang
